page_title: GRA 2-3 VIL | Granada CF v Villarreal 30/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Javier Iglesias Villanueva is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.

90+4' What an amazing save by Filip Jorgensen! Famara Diedhiou (Granada CF) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.

90+4' Njegos Petrovic (Granada CF) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Filip Jorgensen thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
